done.title: आधी रात की सीटी
done.summary: Detective Vikram investigates a young woman's mysterious death in a creepy Banaras haveli, uncovering a lethal plot involving a dead snake, locked rooms, and hidden wealth before receiving a chilling message from the Black Lotus.

done.title: दीवार के अंदर कौन?
done.summary: Detective Vikram uncovers a daring bank heist disguised as a supernatural wall-knocking ghost and an eccentric society for men with a white streak in their hair.

done.title: नीली साड़ी का राज़
done.summary: In 1923 Shimla, a governess hired under bizarre conditions discovers a captive heiress hidden in a locked bungalow wing and uncovers a sinister inheritance trap.

done.title: अनजान कोठी का बुलावा
done.summary: In 1923 Mirzapur, Detective Vikram investigates a secret forest mansion where a young engineer barely escapes a lethal hydraulic trap designed to protect a dangerous counterfeiting operation.

done.title: पाँच काली पंखुड़ियाँ
done.summary: In storm-battered 1923 Banaras, Detective Vikram tries to protect a young man who received five dried black lotus petals, the lethal warning of a ruthless syndicate.

done.title: शापित नीलम
done.summary: On Diwali night in 1923 Banaras, Detective Vikram traces a stolen cursed sapphire hidden inside a dressed duck back to a panicked hotel servant and the scent of kewra.

done.title: खिड़की में दिखा चेहरा
done.summary: In 1923 Banaras, a woman spots her respectable husband screaming from an opium den window before he vanishes, leaving behind a heavily weighted coat in the Ganga and a mysterious scarred beggar in his place.

done.title: झील की चुड़ैल
done.summary: Detective Vikram investigates the mysterious death of a tenant farmer at a misty lake in 1923 Rajputana, exposing a 30-year-old dacoit secret behind a supernatural legend.

done.title: कुत्ता क्यों नहीं भौंका?
done.summary: When a champion white racehorse vanishes and its trainer is found dead on the eve of the Lucknow Cup, Detective Vikram realizes the silent guard dog is the key to solving the mystery.

done.title: तहखाने का मंत्र
done.summary: In 1923 Lucknow, Detective Vikram decrypts an ancient family ritual to uncover a hidden cellar treasure and a tragic crime of passion beneath the Raizada haveli.

done.title: मुट्ठी में फटा कागज़
done.summary: In 1923 Meerut, a murdered coachman dies holding a torn scrap of a note, leading Detective Vikram to uncover a conspiracy between a father and son disguised as a simple burglary.

done.title: पर्दे पर अजीब पंजे
done.summary: In 1923 Meerut cantonment, a British Indian Army colonel dies of fright in a locked room after seeing an old comrade he betrayed, leaving behind mysterious paw prints on the curtain.

done.title: बँधी आँखों का सफ़र
done.summary: An interpreter is kidnapped to translate for a captive Tibetan merchant, leading Vikram and his brother Raghav to uncover a dangerous syndicate.
